entities.name: Rubra
entities.description: An aggressive Elder Dragon with a fierce crest.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon and cousin whose human army challenged Rubra.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Dragon that laid the egg-fall hatching Rubra.

entities.name: Birth of the Elder Dragons
entities.description: Event when the Elder Dragons were hatched.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: War in which Bolas's army challenged Rubra.

events.summary: Rubra is hatched in the second egg-fall by the Ur-Dragon during the Birth of the Elder Dragons.
events.quote: Rubra was hatched during the Birth of the Elder Dragons

events.summary: Human dragon hunters kill most of Rubra's egg-fall, leaving only him and three siblings.
events.quote: after several years only he and his three siblings remained of his egg-fall

events.summary: At the onset of the Elder Dragon War, Bolas's human army challenges Rubra and his brothers; Rubra takes a poisoned bolt to the eye.
events.quote: Rubra took a poisoned bolt to the eye

events.summary: Rubra loses consciousness and falls to earth, where Bolas's army attacks his body.
events.quote: lost consciousness and fell to earth

relations.quote: Rubra and his brothers were challenged by the human army of Nicol Bolas
